contract: ADR 131 ordinary Runner Explorer and ADRs 35, 41, 55, 65, 116, 117, 129 and 130. Registration, authorization, successful read, report and task acceptance are distinct facts.

baseline.legacy: Actual old Goal Runner sends a distinct read-only model projection. Real read refs enter the report. A fake ref never enters the stored report.

firstBroadRuns.mac: One 15-second wait timeout for the large saved Goal artifact case. The original assertions passed on isolated rerun.
firstBroadRuns.linux: One existing PTY poll returned EINTR before its expected scoped approval. The fixture now retries interrupted poll/read against the same deadline and assertions.
firstBroadRuns.final: Exact final tree differs only in the PTY fixture. Both platforms pass all 46 selected cases with two test threads.

verification.positiveReport: Public exec settles the explicit registration. The actual Explorer model receives only the five read tools or the chosen allowed subset. Its real file observation provides the matching Evidence reference. Fabricated refs and unsupported findings are absent. Parent leaf remains pending.
verification.scope: Outside Git, file, list and symlinked search paths get actual denied grants even with full access. A batch lane requests admission for its resolved target and cannot read the outside fixture. Confined directory/file reads use no-follow descriptors and still acknowledge live control.
verification.stopRecovery: During a live worker model request, SIGTERM stops actual cognition and records failure. A hard exit preserves the running facts until the existing recovery proves the owner stopped; recovery marks the same Explorer interrupted without dispatching again. Repeated recovery preserves the result.
verification.oldTuiColdRead: An extracted macOS package executed list, search, batch and read with controlled inputs. Old GoalStore recovered all four original evidence refs; old history projection excluded the six Explorer activity rows from parent history. Goal body, index, change journal and conversation history were byte-identical after read.

limits: Current candidate uses a controlled HTTP model and isolated fixture. Explicit Explorer completes. Automatic Runner inspect and continuation, role-specific model routes, Verifier, derived Goals, old installed Host stop, P4 total gate, P5–P7, long-history acceptance and official installation remain open.
